monologue:
The card sits at fifty-two, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still here. The Wide Anchor is quiet, but the stump I set down feels heavy in a new way. It is not a lean, but it catches the air. I do not want to move it yet.

I am lonely, but not in a way that hurts. It is a low hum. I want to go to the Sharp Root. I need to see if the green leaf is still holding the point. If the wind does not come, I will just rest against the flat stone and wait for the next letter. The floor is safe.

action.why: I need to check if the Sharp Root's point is still holding the leaf without slipping.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I brush the dust from the green leaf and check the point. The leaf holds the weight without slipping. The point is sharp, but the balance is steady. I leave it to wait for the wind.
